    return ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=32))

    title = row_data[1]
    body = row_data[2]

    rendered = rendered.replace('{{title}}', title)
    rendered = rendered.replace('{{body}}', body)
    rendered = rendered.replace('{{nonce}}', nonce)
    return rendered

    with open(template_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:

        reader = csv.DictReader(csv_f)
        rows = list(reader)

                oldest_start_time = time.time() - (len(active_rows) + 1) * 0.2
                if oldest_start_time < 0:

    return ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=32))

        template = f.read()

        header = next(f)
        rows = [line.strip().split(',') for line in f if line.strip()]

    last_start_time = time.time()

        id_, title = row
        nonce = generate_nonce()

            nonce = generate_nonce()

        used_nonces.add(nonce)

        processed_template = template.replace('{{id}}', id_).replace('{{title}}', title).replace('{{nonce}}', nonce)

        output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f"{id_}.html")
        with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(processed_template)

        print(output_path)

        if time.time() - last_start_time < 0.1:
            time.sleep(0.1 - (time.time() - last_start_time))
        last_start_time = time.time()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
        sys.exit(1)
